question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping maintains firm control over the Chinese Communist Party and People’s Liberation Army through extensive anti-corruption purges that have removed senior military and civilian officials since 2023, including multiple Central Military Commission members. These actions, continuing into mid-2026, have reinforced rather than undermined his authority ahead of the 21st Party Congress expected in late 2027. At age 73, Xi shows no public signs of stepping down and has deferred succession planning, with no named heir or elite challenges evident in official proceedings or personnel decisions. Trader consensus at 95.8% for “No” reflects this institutional dominance and lack of disruptive developments. Realistic shifts before 2027 remain limited to unforeseen events such as a major health crisis or rapid elite realignment, neither of which has materialized in recent months.
